evidence: Carries the Validation label and adds ChainstateManager::ValidateBlock to src/validation.cpp, modifying how ConnectBlock and contextual validation can be invoked.
rationale: Introduces ChainstateManager::ValidateBlock to run block contextual checks and ConnectBlock in check-only mode against custom coin views. Because kernel-driven validation entry points directly touch consensus code and script caching, they require deliberate validation review to avoid consensus cache poisoning.
